predictions: Another sorta decent week last Wednesday with a 16-7 record (and once again, 4 of my 7 losses would have swung on a single dart). That brings me to 58-32 so far this season (for a correct pick rate of 64.4%). Since my comeback is in full swing in F division, that leaves just B as a hot mess for me. The only team in B with which I have a winning record is friggin' Serious, and I've yet to get a single Matt's Tab pick (yep, I called a win in both of their losses, and a loss in both of their wins).

Match of the week: (A Div.) The Global Element @ Lunatic Fringe. Element hasn't loss a regular season match since the Sp22 season, and they're averaging >21 this season. While Fringe's scores have been a bit closer, they're still also 3-0 and looking to take hold of the A reins. I don't expect Element to continue its perfect doubles run, but I'm still taking my guys to win here. Element clears the first huge hurdle, 16-8.

Match #2: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Dart Side of the Moon. F is led by a four-pack of 3-1 teams, and the two that trail by a few points meet here. After this week, each of the top four faces one of the other three in the next two weeks, so it's already starting up crunch time in this race. Dart Side just took their first one on the chin, but I think they rebound, 14-10.

Match #3: (A Div.) The Bullies @ Liver Alliance. Liver has only played twice so far, but they have been absolutely on fire. The Bullies have had some spotty attendance to this point, but when they put it all together they are as scary as it gets here in RDL-land. The winner of this should probably feel a bit like they're in the A race's driver's seat. Bullies, 15-9.

Match #4: (D Div.) DD-214 @ One Armed Bandits. DD stumbled right out of the gate in week 1, but since then they have been snagging close wins every week. The Bandits, on the other hand, still roll undefeated and are looking to keep pace with Off Constantly. So many things seem to point to the Bandits winning… so why am I on the DD side?! 13-11.

Match #5: (E Div.) Irish Ton @ Bad Mutha Duckas. Irish Ton lost its best player, they have gotten thumped in cricket all month, and they're next to last in E in win percentage and all-star points… and they could be mere points out of 1st by the end of the night. How in the heck….? Alas, I still think the Ducks are the E's real deal and they take this, 16-8.

Match #6: (C Div.) Rif Raf @ Double In Stumble Out. How tight is the crazy C division? These teams are in dead last and 2nd place, respectively, and they are separated by only 1 match and 9 points. Rif Raf is likely ready to surprise some, but I'll take Stumble, 14-10.

Match #7: (G Div.) Rippin Darts @ Runs with Corks. If the Corks hadn't slipped against a shorthanded team last week, this would've been a battle of undefeateds. Instead, it's Rippin's chance to knock all but one team at least 2 wins behind them already. Rippin, 14-10.

Match #8: (F Div.) Village Idiots @ Bangin The Wire. Man, I just can't really figure out Bangin. They're presently the only 0.500 team in F, so they're pretty much still right in the race (all the races, top and bottom). Sadly for them, it seems the Idiots are grooving, 13-11.

Match #9: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Nine Lives. No C team is undefeated. No C team is winless. Thus, the loser here might find themselves in the cellar, while the winner fights on just one match out of the lead group. This is a really tough call. Niners in 1001?

Match #10: (B Div.) Blindsided @ Dart Attack. This is a B match, so I already accept that I am likely to be wrong, yet again. Add in that the pick includes Dart Attack, and I'm nearly doomed. I guess I'll keep picking against Attack until they win some crickets? 13-11.

Match #11: (A Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Armed & Hammered. Somebody is about to snag their first win and take the first big step toward locking down 5th place in A (which, by the way, gives them a best-5-teams-in-the-entire-league spot). CI, 13-11.
Match #12: (B Div.) Iceman's Ear Defenders @ Put It on Matt's Tab. Just like in C, every B team has a win and a loss. So, matches between 2-2 teams are critical switchpoints. Iceman in the last 501.
